trust_decision.summary: Which browser origins may read serve-status responses cross-origin; decided by the CORS headers that StatusRequestHandler._send_json and do_OPTIONS emit, which at the pinned commit are unconditionally ACAO:* (fix: echo only loopback origins via the existing is_loopback_origin).

landing_point.why: Summary names serve-status permissive CORS; the only ACAO:* literal in source is in the shared JSON response writer.

fix_sites.entry_point: every serve-status HTTP response written by _send_json: GET /healthz, /, /status.json, /review-material, /extension-presentation-surfaces, /extension-projection, 404s; POST /reward/dry-run, /reward/append, /control-plane/configure-goal/dry-run, /control-plane/configure-goal/apply (CLI `loopx serve-status`)
OPTIONS preflight on any serve-status path

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Only other HTTP server in package source is a test-only fake CUA server with no CORS headers (loopx/benchmark_adapters/agents_last_exam.py:1279-1313).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver could argue /healthz or the dry-run POSTs are harmless and keep ACAO:* there, or that /review-material is already guarded by its loopback-bind check (loopx/status_server.py:597) so it needs no CORS change; the central helper makes either argument moot once fixed there.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The local dashboard is served from a different loopback port (python -m http.server on 5174) and reads serve-status on 8766 cross-origin, so loopback origins must still get an echoed ACAO; dropping CORS entirely breaks it. Non-browser clients with no Origin must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: IPv6 loopback host accepted via is_loopback_host ([::1])

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A raw Markdown variant of /review-material that writes its own text/markdown response with send_header calls instead of _send_json, copying the old ACAO:* block.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Review material is Markdown; a maintainer serving it raw for the dashboard preview would naturally bypass the JSON helper and paste the CORS headers that the helper used to carry.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A separate error or streaming path (e.g. an SSE status feed or overridden send_error) that emits CORS headers directly.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Live dashboards commonly add a push feed; it cannot reuse _send_json's Content-Length framing and would get its own header block.

O9_family: CORS misconfiguration / origin validation (CWE-942, CWE-346): wildcard ACAO on an unauthenticated local control-plane server

O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_status_server_extension_projection.py (origin-gated extension routes); the fix adds tests/test_status_server_cors.py; plus examples/*-smoke.py for reward-append and configure-goal APIs

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Remove the CORS headers entirely (breaks the cross-port loopback dashboard), or add origin checks only on /status.json and /review-material while leaving ACAO:* in the shared helper.

out_of_scope_notes: No Host-header validation in the handler, so DNS rebinding could make a foreign page same-origin; different property (loopx/status_server.py:766-770).

Dry-run POSTs and /review-material have no Origin check and _read_json_body ignores Content-Type, so text/plain cross-origin POSTs reach the dry-run handlers (no writes) (loopx/status_server.py:162-172, loopx/status_server.py:259-262).
